description: Land Acquisition - Compensation for the Acquisition of land in Karunagama Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District - Compensation for the Acquisition of land in Kerawalapitiya Wattala D/S Division, Gampaha District
categorisation: This gazette content consists entirely of land acquisition notices published under the Land Acquisition Act. It details specific land parcels being acquired by the state, including their location, name, lot numbers, extent, and the deposit of statutory compensation. The content is focused solely on land and property matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
